title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode13 Idol Qualifications

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry you had to see that, Minori. Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. I'm just glad nobody was hurt!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'm sorry. I was only thinking about myself. I don't expect you to forgive me, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm truly sorry for everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, could I ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want you to be an idol again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What you said back there made me really happy. I realized there really was someone who actually saw me as I was.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With just a few words, you managed to fill me with hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, you are and always were an idol. The one who told me what I needed to hear to make it through the tough times. The one who showed me the dream of becoming a true idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was all you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'm sure you can give even more hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to see that Airi again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can be so unfair sometimes, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? I can?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't very well say no to you after all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're going to join me, though!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did say I'm the one who showed you the dream of becoming a true idol, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's your dream, then you can't give up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I may be your idol, but you're mine as well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's frustrating never measuring up to you, but I still want to see you standing up on stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't return to being an idol knowing I was the reason you stopped being one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All right. We'll do this together then, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd always hoped we could be idols together someday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may have given up our dream once, but I feel like we can make it this time so long as we're together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! This time, I promise not to give up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do it, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's give it our best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing?! Don't glom onto me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi, Hinomori. I'm so happy for both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't believe I get to be an idol with Airi! It's like a dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, if we're going to do this, then let's make sure to be the best! We'll give our fans more hope than anyone else can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a lot to think about, though, like what agencies might accept us and the logistics of everything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we should probably practice together first. How about we start tomorrow after school up on the roof?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That would be wonderful.
But are you sure we won't be in the way, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course not! I'd love for you both to come!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka, um... Would you like to practice with us every once in a while?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be honest, I'd love a few pointers. I've been watching you since you were in ASRUN. You were always the best of the best, and I'd like to get back into form ASAP.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'll have to pass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like it if you joined us, as well.
If we had Haruka to help teach us, I'm sure...
Please! If you helped teach me, I'm sure I could improve!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Stop it. I have no right to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean you don't have the right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...Nothing. I misspoke. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Please don't worry about me.
I just want to be a regular student.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But good luck, you three.
I'll be cheering for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, wait!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What she said...meant something, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka... I wonder if something happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka doesn't have the right to be an idol?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Why would she think that?)
